issue.title: Timeout error while uploading and downloading mission
issue.body:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/1316

Hello @julianoes I am facing the same problem while uploading and downloading the mission file. Currently I'm using raspberry pi5. for running the script. my script work fine while running in laptop using UDP connection. But when I run the came script in pi5 changing the connection type to serial dev/ttyAMA0 i receive time out error. I also tried to build the custom mavsdk server as mentioned by you by changing "static constexpr double timeout_s = 2" still I reseive the time out error. I think I did some mistake while building the server. Could help me build the server for pi os with Raspberrry pi =5 architecture ?

comments.body: Is the serial port on the RPi actually running? Can you confirm mavlink bytes are arriving?

Hello @julianoes ,

I still get time out error while uploading mission, and terminal of server show, sending again after 0.507331s. I have attached the terminal output of server and code![test.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a5027ec-59bb-46f6-894b-b0e476d34919)


[mission_upload_test_code.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19894240/mission_upload_test_code.txt)

I tried changing double timeouts value but that too did not work,
Initially I was using AMA0 port (telem 2 to Rpi pin 6 8 and 10 ) for connecting Rpi and pixhawk, which was communicating slowly. After I switched to USB to USB connection using ACM0 and ACM1, the timeout problem was solved. Now there is no timeout issue now.

But using a USB connection for the Rpi and Pixhawk, I cannot use pixhawk's another usb port for connecting to GCS(QGC) on laptop  using USB cable for HITL test. 

Do you have any Idea how to solve that issue? @julianoes

You will have to fix the RPi's AMA0 port. I suspect it is misconfigured and has the console or bluetooth or something conflicting. I definitely have had that working with RPi5 at a baudrate of 3000000

issue.title: MAVSDK/src/core unavailable while cloning MAVSDK

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
While cloning MAVSDK from https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git, the core and others submodule inside MAVSDK/src were not cloned. 

Even when I tried downloading the ZIP file, I was unable to get all the submodules. 

I also tried git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git, but that did not work either.
